case: Mixed-case quoted enum identifiers against lowercase-folded shadow names
contract: Metadata lookup retains the exact mixed-case schema and enum type name.
A keyed update and structured filter select the mixed-case target enum while lowercased schema and type names occur first in search_path.
Native pg_type and sibling-row checks prove that only the intended target row changed and the lowercase shadow row remained intact.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration quoted_enum_identifier_contract::value_contract_mixed_case_enum_identifiers_resist_folded_shadow_names -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other identifier forms and transaction/session search_path permutations remain open; this focused case does not close the PostgreSQL enum or broader B3 matrix.
